rules:
Per-bank gross and net TTM charge-off rates for the credit-suite roster, by
product, 2006-2026, from every FDIC filing already pulled. Writes peers.json.

A bank-product TTM value is left out when:
  - any quarter in its window (the four quarters plus the one before, whose
    year-to-date the first quarter's flow is measured from) has a balance move
    over 25% on the quarter: a merger, sale or reclassification, not credit;
  - the average balance is under $1bn: a few loans swing the rate. KeyBank
    is exempt: it is drawn as itself, never part of the composite.
The composite is the 15 peers' summed flows over their summed balances, using
only the values kept. KeyBank is shown, never in the composite.
